villa_snapshot: Property snapshot

Set on a quiet, 1-acre forest-framed stretch of tropical land, this pet-friendly tented hideaway offers a serene, open-air living experience rooted in rustic textures and bohemian charm. The bedroom is a light-washed sanctuary, featuring a four-poster canopy bed, rattan wardrobes, woven pendant lights, and sliding glass doors that blur the line between indoors and out. Paired with forest views, soft natural light, and layered organic accents, this 400 sq. ft. space invites deep rest and barefoot ease.

Step outside to your private patio, where a raw-wood dining table and wicker seating are arranged beneath a layered canopy roof. Thoughtful details like a sculptural Buddha head, potted palms, and a textured stone floor set the mood for long, lingering afternoons or candle-lit evenings surrounded by greenery.

The ensuite bath continues the earthy palette with a grey-stone tub, indoor plants, and warm ambient lighting. Sculptural wooden elements and a clean layout bring a meditative energy ideal for slow rituals and evening wind-downs.

Beyond the tent, guests have access to expansive shared spaces designed for both reflection and connection. A Moroccan-style pool sits at the heart of the estate, framed by tall palms and whitewashed decks dotted with loungers and sculptural accents. The garden paths are lined with swings, bamboo benches, and lush greenery that invites quiet exploration.

A charming thatched-roof gazebo with an elevated wooden deck and rattan seating offers a breezy open-air setting- perfect for slow mornings, quiet reading, or afternoon conversations. As dusk settles in, guests can gather by the sunken stone firepit, where wild landscaping and soft ambient lighting set the stage for starlit chats and fireside warmth.

Enhancing the stay is a warm, attentive hospitality team that embodies the spirit of Atithi Devo Bhava. From a dedicated butler to a thoughtfully curated welcome basket and a well-stocked fridge, every detail is seamlessly taken care of—ensuring guests feel effortlessly pampered and genuinely welcomed. This is a space for stillness, connection, and slow, soulful living.
